column8: Dialogue
Our stores are running dangerously low. Get this food here before the workers go hungry.
The clinic has almost nothing left. People are waiting for medicine we cannot provide.
The pumps have broken down again. Bring us machinery before the whole district loses its water supply.
The generators are our only source of power tonight. We need fuel immediately.
We cannot keep defending ourselves with scraps. Send weapons before the patrol returns.
We have enough hands to distribute the rations, but not enough food to fill them.
The hospital generator is failing. Without fuel, the patients will be left without power.
Production has slowed to an unacceptable level. Send machinery and restore the factory immediately.
Our private reserves are running low. We expect priority delivery before the next departure.
The kitchens are preparing for an important gathering. Do not disappoint our guests.
The upper district cannot afford another outbreak. Deliver these medical supplies immediately.
There have been disturbances below the city. Our security forces require additional weapons.
Our transport fleet cannot remain grounded. Deliver the machinery needed for repairs.
A shortage has reached the upper district. Deliver the requested rations before supplies become scarce.
One of the district generators has failed. We require replacement machinery immediately.
Tensions below the city are increasing. Our guards need more equipment.
Several settlements have combined their remaining supplies. We need your ship to distribute them.
Something is spreading through the district. The clinic needs medicine before the outbreak worsens.
Without these parts, the local workshops will stop producing essential goods.
Fuel shipments have stopped arriving. Every generator in the district is being rationed.
Don't ask where these are going. Just make sure they arrive before the patrols notice.
The banquet cannot proceed without the requested provisions. Ensure the delivery arrives on schedule.
Our physicians have been instructed to maintain a private reserve. Deliver the medicine without delay.
The factory is expanding again. More machinery means greater production and greater profit.
Several airships are waiting to depart. Deliver fuel before the fleet falls behind schedule.
Security has approved a new weapons contract. Deliver the shipment discreetly.
The settlement needs both food and medical supplies. We will accept whatever help you can provide.
The workshop is almost completely shut down. Bring the parts and we'll get production moving again.
Something is coming. We need weapons now, and we'll trade our remaining food to get them.
